1.explanation: In this example we set up a fresh Storybook instance, install Carbon React, and add @storybook/addon-docs. We then create an MDX story that imports the UIShell components and invokes `<Props />` without specifying which component’s props to show. When you run `npm run storybook` and view the Docs tab for this story, you’ll see exactly the same “undefined” tab and empty prop table that was reported in the bug. This minimal reproduction isolates the issue to the interaction between the MDX <Props> helper and the UIShell component exports.
1.bug_scenario: When you open the UIShell section in Carbon’s React Storybook (e.g. the “Fixed SideNav” story under UIShell) and click the “Docs” tab, the Component API panel renders a tab labeled “undefined” (and tabs for each sub‐component) but shows “No inputs found for this component.” The props tables never get populated.
